axis-3.ini:
; BetterLinuxCNC axis profile from axis-5.ini
; XYZ direction commissioning only; homing and machining remain blocked.
[KINS]
JOINTS = 3
KINEMATICS = trivkins coordinates=XYZ

[TRAJ]
COORDINATES = XYZ
LINEAR_UNITS = mm
ANGULAR_UNITS = degree
MAX_LINEAR_VELOCITY = 0.5
DEFAULT_LINEAR_VELOCITY = 0.5
MAX_LINEAR_ACCELERATION = 5
NO_FORCE_HOMING = 0

[DISPLAY]
PROGRAM_PREFIX = /var/lib/betterlinuxcnc/programs
DISPLAY = betterlinuxcnc
GEOMETRY = XYZ
MAX_LINEAR_VELOCITY = 0.5
DEFAULT_LINEAR_VELOCITY = 0.5
MIN_LINEAR_VELOCITY = 0.01
MAX_FEED_OVERRIDE = 1

[SPINDLE_0]
MAX_FORWARD_VELOCITY = 0

[BETTERCNC_PLATFORM]
MACHINING_WIDTH_MM = 400
MACHINING_LENGTH_MM = 600
MACHINING_DEPTH_MM = 90
MATERIAL_CLEARANCE_MM = 130
TABLE_WIDTH_MM = 480
TABLE_LENGTH_MM = 800
REPEATABILITY_MM = 0.01
SPINDLE_POWER_W = 2200
SPINDLE_COOLING = WATER
STEPPER_MOTOR = 57-3A
BALL_SCREW = 1605
SUPPLY_VOLTAGE_AC_V = 220
SUPPLY_FREQUENCY_HZ = 50
MACHINE_WIDTH_MM = 650
MACHINE_LENGTH_MM = 850
MACHINE_HEIGHT_MM = 510
APPROX_MACHINE_MASS_KG = 68

[BETTERCNC_CRADLE_REFERENCE]
TILT_PIVOT_HEIGHT_MM = 40
LEVEL_PLATTER_FACE_HEIGHT_MM = 65
PLATTER_FACE_OUTER_RADIUS_MM = 37
PEAK_PLATTER_FACE_HEIGHT_MM = 84.65
FIXED_END_SUPPORT_HEIGHT_MM = 90

[BETTERCNC_HOMING]
PROFILE = zhulong-v2
SWITCH_INPUTS_VERIFIED = YES
MOTOR_MAPPING_VERIFIED = NO
MOTOR_DIRECTIONS_VERIFIED = NO
CONFIGURATION_REVISION = bc-xyz-jog-20261124

[AXIS_X]
ESTIMATED_TRAVEL = 600
MIN_LIMIT = 0
MAX_LIMIT = 580
MAX_VELOCITY = 0.5
MAX_ACCELERATION = 5

[JOINT_0]
TYPE = LINEAR
STEP_SCALE = 320
MIN_LIMIT = 0
MAX_LIMIT = 580
MAX_VELOCITY = 0.5
MAX_ACCELERATION = 5
STEPGEN_MAXVEL = 0.625
STEPGEN_MAXACCEL = 6.25
DIRSETUP = 10000
DIRHOLD = 10000
STEPLEN = 5000
STEPSPACE = 5000
FERROR = 0.5
MIN_FERROR = 0.05
HOME_SEQUENCE = 1000
HOME_USE_INDEX = NO

[AXIS_Y]
ESTIMATED_TRAVEL = 400
MIN_LIMIT = 0
MAX_LIMIT = 380
MAX_VELOCITY = 0.5
MAX_ACCELERATION = 5

[JOINT_1]
TYPE = LINEAR
STEP_SCALE = 320
MIN_LIMIT = 0
MAX_LIMIT = 380
MAX_VELOCITY = 0.5
MAX_ACCELERATION = 5
STEPGEN_MAXVEL = 0.625
STEPGEN_MAXACCEL = 6.25
DIRSETUP = 10000
DIRHOLD = 10000
STEPLEN = 5000
STEPSPACE = 5000
FERROR = 0.5
MIN_FERROR = 0.05
HOME_SEQUENCE = 1000
HOME_USE_INDEX = NO

[AXIS_Z]
ESTIMATED_TRAVEL = 90
MIN_LIMIT = -50
MAX_LIMIT = 0
MAX_VELOCITY = 0.5
MAX_ACCELERATION = 5

[JOINT_2]
TYPE = LINEAR
STEP_SCALE = 320
MIN_LIMIT = -50
MAX_LIMIT = 0
MAX_VELOCITY = 0.5
MAX_ACCELERATION = 5
STEPGEN_MAXVEL = 0.625
STEPGEN_MAXACCEL = 6.25
DIRSETUP = 10000
DIRHOLD = 10000
STEPLEN = 5000
STEPSPACE = 5000
FERROR = 0.5
MIN_FERROR = 0.05
HOME_SEQUENCE = 1000
HOME_USE_INDEX = NO

[EMC]
VERSION = 1.1
MACHINE = Zhulong V2 XYZ - direction commissioning

[TASK]
TASK = milltask
CYCLE_TIME = 0.010

[RS274NGC]
PARAMETER_FILE = /var/lib/betterlinuxcnc/machine/linuxcnc.var
RS274NGC_STARTUP_CODE = G21 G40 G90 G94 G97

[EMCMOT]
EMCMOT = motmod
HOMEMOD = zhulong_homing
SERVO_PERIOD = 1000000
COMM_TIMEOUT = 1.0

[EMCIO]
EMCIO = io
CYCLE_TIME = 0.100
TOOL_TABLE = /var/lib/betterlinuxcnc/machine/tool.tbl

[HAL]
HALFILE = bc-xyz-jog.hal
bc-xyz-jog.hal:
# XYZ direction commissioning: X=AXIS0, Y=AXIS1, Z=AXIS2.
# Only the three step generators are outputs. No spindle or rotary output is loaded.
loadrt [KINS]KINEMATICS
loadrt [EMCMOT]EMCMOT servo_period_nsec=[EMCMOT]SERVO_PERIOD num_joints=[KINS]JOINTS
loadrt hostmot2
loadrt hm2_eth board_ip="10.10.10.10" config="num_stepgens=3 num_pwmgens=0 num_encoders=0 sserial_port_0=xxxxxxxx num_dplls=0 num_leds=0"
loadrt debounce cfg=3

setp hm2_7i92.0.watchdog.timeout_ns 5000000
setp debounce.0.delay 5
setp motion.homing-inhibit true

addf hm2_7i92.0.read servo-thread
addf debounce.0 servo-thread
addf motion-command-handler servo-thread
addf motion-controller servo-thread
addf hm2_7i92.0.write servo-thread

# This installation has no wired external E-stop input. Software reset and power-on
# remain separate operator commands; neither loading this HAL nor connecting enables motion.
net software-estop iocontrol.0.user-enable-out => iocontrol.0.emc-enable-in

# Feedback below counts emitted steps; it does not measure the motor or screw.
setp hm2_7i92.0.stepgen.00.position-scale [JOINT_0]STEP_SCALE
setp hm2_7i92.0.stepgen.00.maxvel [JOINT_0]STEPGEN_MAXVEL
setp hm2_7i92.0.stepgen.00.maxaccel [JOINT_0]STEPGEN_MAXACCEL
setp hm2_7i92.0.stepgen.00.dirsetup [JOINT_0]DIRSETUP
setp hm2_7i92.0.stepgen.00.dirhold [JOINT_0]DIRHOLD
setp hm2_7i92.0.stepgen.00.steplen [JOINT_0]STEPLEN
setp hm2_7i92.0.stepgen.00.stepspace [JOINT_0]STEPSPACE
setp hm2_7i92.0.stepgen.00.step_type 0
setp hm2_7i92.0.stepgen.00.control-type 0
net x-command joint.0.motor-pos-cmd => hm2_7i92.0.stepgen.00.position-cmd
net x-feedback hm2_7i92.0.stepgen.00.position-fb => joint.0.motor-pos-fb
net x-enable joint.0.amp-enable-out => hm2_7i92.0.stepgen.00.enable
net x-switch-raw hm2_7i92.0.gpio.020.in => debounce.0.0.in
net x-neg-limit debounce.0.0.out => joint.0.neg-lim-sw-in joint.0.home-sw-in

setp hm2_7i92.0.stepgen.01.position-scale [JOINT_1]STEP_SCALE
setp hm2_7i92.0.stepgen.01.maxvel [JOINT_1]STEPGEN_MAXVEL
setp hm2_7i92.0.stepgen.01.maxaccel [JOINT_1]STEPGEN_MAXACCEL
setp hm2_7i92.0.stepgen.01.dirsetup [JOINT_1]DIRSETUP
setp hm2_7i92.0.stepgen.01.dirhold [JOINT_1]DIRHOLD
setp hm2_7i92.0.stepgen.01.steplen [JOINT_1]STEPLEN
setp hm2_7i92.0.stepgen.01.stepspace [JOINT_1]STEPSPACE
setp hm2_7i92.0.stepgen.01.step_type 0
setp hm2_7i92.0.stepgen.01.control-type 0
net y-command joint.1.motor-pos-cmd => hm2_7i92.0.stepgen.01.position-cmd
net y-feedback hm2_7i92.0.stepgen.01.position-fb => joint.1.motor-pos-fb
net y-enable joint.1.amp-enable-out => hm2_7i92.0.stepgen.01.enable
net y-switch-raw hm2_7i92.0.gpio.021.in => debounce.0.1.in
net y-neg-limit debounce.0.1.out => joint.1.neg-lim-sw-in joint.1.home-sw-in

setp hm2_7i92.0.stepgen.02.position-scale [JOINT_2]STEP_SCALE
setp hm2_7i92.0.stepgen.02.maxvel [JOINT_2]STEPGEN_MAXVEL
setp hm2_7i92.0.stepgen.02.maxaccel [JOINT_2]STEPGEN_MAXACCEL
setp hm2_7i92.0.stepgen.02.dirsetup [JOINT_2]DIRSETUP
setp hm2_7i92.0.stepgen.02.dirhold [JOINT_2]DIRHOLD
setp hm2_7i92.0.stepgen.02.steplen [JOINT_2]STEPLEN
setp hm2_7i92.0.stepgen.02.stepspace [JOINT_2]STEPSPACE
setp hm2_7i92.0.stepgen.02.step_type 0
setp hm2_7i92.0.stepgen.02.control-type 0
net z-command joint.2.motor-pos-cmd => hm2_7i92.0.stepgen.02.position-cmd
net z-feedback hm2_7i92.0.stepgen.02.position-fb => joint.2.motor-pos-fb
net z-enable joint.2.amp-enable-out => hm2_7i92.0.stepgen.02.enable
net z-switch-raw hm2_7i92.0.gpio.022.in => debounce.0.2.in
net z-neg-limit debounce.0.2.out => joint.2.neg-lim-sw-in joint.2.home-sw-in
